knowledge:
- key_parameters: species=character string specifying the species ('Human', 'Mouse', 'Rat', 'Dog', or 'Rhesus') ;; geneSetSource=character string ('GOBP', 'GOMF', 'GOCC', 'KEGG', 'REACTOME') or a custom data.frame containing PATHWAYID, PATHWAYNAME, TAXID, and GENEID columns ;; entrezIdentifiers=character vector of Entrez Gene IDs for which gene statistics are available ;; geneStatistic=named numeric vector of gene-level statistics (typically p-values) where names are Entrez Gene IDs ;; minGenes=minimal number of genes for a gene set to be considered in the analysis (default 5) ;; maxGenes=maximal number of genes for a gene set to be considered in the analysis (default 100) ;; rowPermutations=logical indicating whether critical values are computed using gene statistic permutations (default TRUE) ;; nPermutations=number of permutations for calculating critical values ;; smoothPValues=logical indicating whether smoothing is desirable (default TRUE) ;; probabilityVector=vector of probabilities for critical value curves ;; df=degrees of freedom for the smoothing parameter (default 9)
- alternatives: The documentation mentions using limma (specifically eBayes and topTable) to calculate the input gene-level p-values. It also suggests using BrainArray annotation packages instead of standard Affymetrix annotations for better probe-to-gene mapping.
- when_to_use: Use this analysis when you want to identify biological pathways or functional groups enriched with small p-values from a differential expression analysis, without requiring an arbitrary significance cutoff at the individual gene level, and when pathways may contain a mix of up-regulated and down-regulated genes.
- pitfalls: The gene statistics (p-values) must have a uniform distribution between 0 and 1 under the null hypothesis. Entrez Gene IDs must be used as the gene identifiers (e.g., stripping "_at" suffixes from Affymetrix probe IDs). Column permutations are not fully implemented; rowPermutations = TRUE should be used. GO graph visualization (type = "GOgraph") is only supported if geneSetSource is 'GOBP', 'GOMF', or 'GOCC'.

workflows.name: mlp_pathway_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform pathway enrichment analysis on gene expression p-values using the Mean Log P-value (MLP) method and visualize the results.
input: expressionSetGcrma.rda (an ExpressionSet object containing normalized gene expression data)
mouse4302 (the annotation package name corresponding to the expression data)
workflows.stages: 1. Calculate gene-level p-values using limma ;; 2. Retrieve gene sets for the target species and source using getGeneSets ;; 3. Run the MLP pathway analysis using MLP ;; 4. Visualize results using plot with types "quantileCurves", "barplot", or "GOgraph" ;; 5. Visualize individual gene significance within a specific gene set using plotGeneSetSignificance
workflows.code:
require(MLP)
require(limma)
library(AnnotationDbi)

pathExampleData <- system.file("exampleFiles", "expressionSetGcrma.rda", package = "MLP")
load(pathExampleData)
annotation(expressionSetGcrma) <- "mouse4302"

group <- as.numeric(factor(pData(expressionSetGcrma)$subGroup1, levels = c("WT", "KO")))-1
design <- model.matrix(~group)
fit <- lmFit(exprs(expressionSetGcrma), design)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit)
results <- limma:::topTable(fit2, coef = "group", adjust.method = "fdr", number = Inf)
pvalues <- results[,"P.Value"]
names(pvalues) <- rownames(results)
names(pvalues) <- sub("_at", "", names(pvalues))	

geneSet <- getGeneSets(species = "Mouse", 
		geneSetSource = "GOCC", 
		entrezIdentifiers = names(pvalues)
)

set.seed(111)
mlpOut <- MLP(
		geneSet = geneSet, 
		geneStatistic = pvalues, 
		minGenes = 5, 
		maxGenes = 100, 
		rowPermutations = TRUE, 
		nPermutations = 50, 
		smoothPValues = TRUE, 
    probabilityVector = c(0.5, 0.9, 0.95, 0.99, 0.999, 0.9999, 0.99999), 
		df = 9) 	

plot(mlpOut, type = "quantileCurves")

plot(mlpOut, type = "barplot", ylab = "-log10(gene set p-value)")

plot(mlpOut, type = "GOgraph", nRow = 10, nCutDescPath = 15)

geneSetID <- rownames(mlpOut)[1]
plotGeneSetSignificance(
		geneSet = geneSet, 
		geneSetIdentifier = geneSetID, 
		geneStatistic = pvalues, 
		annotationPackage = annotation(expressionSetGcrma)
)
